import numpy as np

# Normal run (r3): same 3 inputs as r7 inputs 0-2
data_normal = np.load("/work/fwd/r3/run.npz")
data_ablated = np.load("/work/fwd/r7/run.npz")

# Compare L0_MLP writes: inputs 0,1,2 are same in both runs
# r3: inputs 0,1,2 correspond to same sequences as r7 inputs 0,1,2

mlp_normal = data_normal["L0_MLP"]  # [7, 10, 24]
mlp_ablated = data_ablated["L0_MLP"]  # [6, 10, 24]

print("L0_MLP write comparison (normal vs L0H0-ablated):")
for inp_idx in range(3):
    print(f"\nInput {inp_idx}:")
    diff = mlp_normal[inp_idx] - mlp_ablated[inp_idx]
    diff_norm = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=-1)
    normal_norm = np.linalg.norm(mlp_normal[inp_idx], axis=-1)
    print(f"  Normal L0_MLP norm: {np.round(normal_norm, 1)}")
    print(f"  Ablated L0_MLP norm: {np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp_ablated[inp_idx], axis=-1), 1)}")
    print(f"  Diff norm: {np.round(diff_norm, 1)}")
    print(f"  Relative diff: {np.round(diff_norm / (normal_norm + 1e-9), 3)}")
